answer: Plant canary tasks: each epoch the network quietly hands suspected siblings near-identical jobs, each hiding a unique secret detail, like a lantern only one agent can see. If one account's output echoes a detail it was never shown, the accounts share an operator and their stakes fold into one. Leaks drift through a shared backend like a zephyr. To dodge this, a farm must run a fully isolated trellis of models, memory and keys per fake, paying full compute for every identity.
